findings.description: The Lambda environment contains an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. These credentials are exposed to anyone who can read the Terraform state or Lambda configuration, and can be extracted from the deployed function environment.
The function uses Node.js 12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the Lambda execution environment.
